name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
🗂️ Google Drive Hierarchical Tree: Top-level subfolders initially collapsed matching Drive structure, expanding into nested sub-subfolders and media files on tap.
☑️ Multi-Level Tri-State Checkboxes: Interactive parent-child checkbox synchronization with indeterminate selection states.
📁 Custom Save Location Routing: Full SAF DocumentTree support ensuring media and batch ZIP files save directly to user-selected folders.
📦 Reliable Batch ZIP Creation: Fixed atomic completion tracking so ZIP packages always compile and index properly upon batch completion.
⚡ 5x Faster Drive Analysis: Parallel folder crawling and streamlined metadata probing in both Mobile App and Adobe CEP extension.
